info.title: SuperPipeline decisions
info.description: Human decisions written back to a board, and the pending reads that feed them. Written from SuperPipeline's routes on main (apps/api/src/routes/boards/gates.ts, cards.ts, checks.ts and service-routes.ts), not from its zod package. Every refusal is error.v1; its `detail` carries what the producer adds, such as GATE_NOT_PENDING's `reason`. A pending list item is the pushed event body, by reference, so a pushed body and a read body are one contract.

get.summary: Every gate still waiting on a person
get.description: The read half of the carrier's sweep for `gate.pending`. Each item is the pushed body, from the same builder.

get.summary: One gate, including how it was decided
get.description: A gate decided on the web is settled in the room too by this read.

post.description: A person decides a gate, on the web or through a service carrying their answer. A quorum gate short of its quorum records the approval and stays pending; the card is returned either way. Who decided comes from the credential, never the body.

post.summary: Pull a held approval back before its release time
post.description: Request changes in effect: the card returns to the gate's return stage with the comment as feedback. A decider of the gate, or a workspace owner or admin by the role in the token.

post.summary: Change how an approved post is delivered
post.description: Switch the mode, record the live link of a manual post, or schedule a reminder. Never changes the approved bytes. A decider of the gate only.

200.description: The card and the gate's delivery state.

get.summary: Every manual delivery still owed its live link
get.description: The read half of the carrier's sweep for `delivery.pending`.

get.summary: Every question still waiting on a person
get.description: The read half of the carrier's sweep for `elicitation.pending`. A person and a service holding `approval-requests:relay` also see broker approval requests; an agent sees card questions only. A question absent from the list can no longer be answered.

post.summary: Answer an agent's question, or a broker approval request
post.description: A person answers. An `elc_` id is a card question: the card goes back to work and the asking agent reads the answer from its run. An `apr_` id is a broker approval request, answered `allow_once` (a workspace owner or admin) or `deny`. The asker never answers its own question.

200.description: The answered question with its card, or the decided approval request.

get.summary: Every card waiting on a person for a reason chat carries
get.description: The read half of the carrier's sweep for `attention.pending`. A card no longer listed, or listed under another `waitId`, has stopped waiting on that wait.

post.summary: Return a waiting card to its stage, or an earlier one
post.description: A person only; an agent's credential is refused. The comment joins the card's thread and is the feedback the next attempt reads.

200.description: The card, re-queued, and the comment.

post.summary: Archive a card as a person
post.description: The `archive` answer to a waiting card, and the board's own archive with a remark. Archiving ends a pending review or question. An already archived card is returned unchanged.

200.description: The archived card, and the comment when one was given.

get.description: The checks of the card's latest arrival at a stage with checks, or null when it never reached one.

post.description: A workspace owner or admin, by the role in the token, passes a pending check, or a failed one the card still waits on. Never an agent, never the producer of the work.

200.description: The card and its checks after the override.

personToken.description: An Organization-plane access token for a human principal (`principalKind: human`), issued by Accounts. A service carrying a person's answer (a chat carrier) presents a token minted for that person whose `act.sub` names the service speaking for them (RFC 8693 actor); the board then records the decision as made over chat. The roles are the board's capabilities: `read` for reads, `work` for every write here. Workspace owner and admin acts read `orgRole` from the token, never a local membership. The web app's session cookie is the same person and is not a crossing.

agentToken.description: An agent's credential: a `spa_` token, or an Organization-plane token for an agent principal. It reads the pending lists, one gate and a card's checks, and never decides. It sees card questions only, never broker approval requests.

serviceToken.description: An Organization-plane token for a service principal (`principalKind: service`) whose `scope` holds the grant: `gates:read` for the gate, delivery, attention and check reads, `approval-requests:relay` for the question list. The tenant comes from the token; a board in another tenant is 404 BOARD_NOT_FOUND. A service token never reaches a write here.

elicitationId.name: elicitationId
elicitationId.description: A card question (`elc_`) or a broker approval request (`apr_`).

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or refused as input.

Forbidden.description: The caller may not do this.

NotFound.description: The board, or what the path names, does not exist.

Conflict.description: The board's state refuses the act now.

GateDecision.description: SuperPipeline's GateDecision (packages/contract primitives.ts). A decision must also be one of the gate's own options; one that is not is 400 GATE_DECISION_NOT_ALLOWED, on every gate.

TaskState.description: The A2A task states; `canceled` with one l, as A2A spells it.

GateOption.description: An option as the board stores it (GateOption, board/gate-option.ts). The pushed and pending bodies rename `name`/`title` to `id`/`label`; this is the board's own read shape.

ApprovalSubjectView.description: A frozen approval subject with its canonical payload (ApprovalSubjectView).

canonical.description: Any JSON value: the kind's canonical payload.

ApprovalSubjectEnvelope.description: A subject as a decision envelope carries it (gate.v2 §3): identity, expiry and the bounded preview.

Delivery.description: How an approved publishing subject is delivered (GateView.delivery).

GateView.description: One gate, including how it was decided (GateView, board/views.ts). `status` includes `cancelled`, which the board writes when a card is moved or archived with a review pending, though the producer's type leaves it out.

decision.description: The decision recorded, or null while pending or once cancelled. A gate closed because its subject expired carries the board's expired marker.

summary.description: What is being approved, as plain text; absent when the gate binds a subject.

CardView.description: A card as every board route returns it (CardView, board/model.ts).

spec.description: Any JSON value: the card's spec.

CardWithDelivery.description: The card, with the gate's delivery state beside its own fields (the board returns `CardView & { delivery }`).

ElicitationView.description: An agent's question to a person, with its answer once given (ElicitationView, board/views.ts).

ApprovalRequestView.description: A broker approval request as the board records it (ApprovalRequestView, board/views.ts).

CommentView.description: A remark on a card (CommentView, board/views.ts).

CardChecksView.description: The checks of a card's latest arrival at a stage with checks (CardChecksView).

ExpectedWaitId.description: The `waitId` of the `attention.pending` the answer was given for. A card no longer in that wait refuses 409 WAIT_CHANGED and nothing is written.

approvalSubjectId.description: The subject the person saw; required by a gate that binds one, and the chosen variant's on a variant gate.

comment.description: Not blank, and at most 8192 bytes of UTF-8 once trimmed (the maxLength is the character bound that follows from it).

liveUrl.description: An absolute https URL where the post went live.

AnswerElicitationRequest.description: An option, free text, or both. On an `apr_` broker approval request only `option` (`allow_once` or `deny`) and `subject` are read.

subject.description: The subject the person saw, required to approve a question that binds one. The producer reads anything but two strings as no binding.

comment.description: Not blank, and at most 8192 bytes of UTF-8 once trimmed (the maxLength is the character bound that follows from it).

toStageKey.description: The card's stage (the default) or an earlier one.

comment.description: Not blank, and at most 8192 bytes of UTF-8 once trimmed (the maxLength is the character bound that follows from it).

AnswerElicitationResponse.description: A card question answers with the card and the question; an `apr_` broker approval request answers with the request.
